title: AE40031: Computational Fluid Dynamics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE21002, AE31003
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsIntroduction to grid generation;
various grid generation techniques; finite difference method, convergence and
stability, explicit and implicit methods; finite difference method applied to
model equations; Numerical solutions Euler equations, incompressible and
compressible Navier-Stokes equations, Concepts of flux splitting and limiters.
